semiconductor_relevance: High — Otsuka Electronics Korea specializes in measurement devices and optoelectrical testing systems that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and quality assurance.
summary: Otsuka Electronics Korea develops advanced measurement devices and optoelectrical testing systems, contributing significantly to the semiconductor industry. Established in 2003, the company has positioned itself as a leader in R&D, focusing on innovative solutions that enhance the high-tech sector.

regional_presence.Korea: Otsuka Electronics Korea was established in 2003 and operates as an independent R&D company in the region.
